name: Post-Quantum Cipher Analysis
summary: Heimdall — one ▶ Run reads certificate crypto (RSA / ECC / DSA are broken by Shor), TLS/SSH key exchange, OpenSSH/OpenSSL versions and Tenable's Post-Quantum plugins (277650 / 277652 / 277653). Metrics: share of the estate quantum-vulnerable, certificates still valid at the CNSA 2.0 deadlines (2030 / 2033), harvest-now exposure, legacy stacks, crown jewels and KEV overlap. Ranks a migration roadmap and tags the assets: Post-Quantum, PQC Priority, PQC Risk, PQC Harvest-Now, PQC Transport, PQC Agility.
